paired_vs_selected.method: Diebold-Mariano test of equal mean squared CV error (Newey-West variance, bonds ordered by maturity) and 95% moving-block bootstrap interval (block 10) for the RMSE difference; 'significantly worse' needs both

paired_blocked_vs_selected.method: as paired_vs_selected, on errors from contiguous maturity-block folds (each fold holds out a whole stretch of the curve)
